SageTVPlugin.Name: OpenSageTV Vibe Core MCP Plugin
SageTVPlugin.Author: OpenSageTV Vibe
SageTVPlugin.Description: Authenticated, bounded SageTV server controls for an external MCP adapter. Runs with unmodified stock Sage.jar and exposes no arbitrary API, filesystem, or shell access.
SageTVPlugin.ReleaseNotes: Stock-compatible exact-path, playback, seek, caption, live-channel, library-scan, diagnostics, and DVD control bridge for external MCP automation.
